name: How do I know if my existing wall insulation needs to be upgraded or replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my existing wall insulation needs to be upgraded or replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your wall insulation might need upgrading. If you notice inconsistent temperatures between rooms, high energy bills despite moderate usage, or excessive drafts, your insulation may be insufficient. Older homes often have outdated or deteriorated insulation that has settled, allowing for significant heat loss. A professional energy audit can precisely identify areas of heat loss and recommend specific solutions, such as adding more insulation to existing walls or replacing old materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for high energy bills, inconsistent room temperatures, or drafts. Older homes often benefit from insulation upgrades. A professional audit can confirm the need.
